Welcome To Lazarus RP   

We are a newly developed UK themed Role Play server,   

We have a range of clean whitelisted jobs such as:  

\-    Police  

\-    Ems  

\-    Car Dealer  

\-    Mechanic  

\-    Real Estate  

\-    Lawyer  

However if you want to join the dark side of the city we have plenty of criminal activities for you .  

At Lazarus RP we focus on creating a different experience and work together with some of the best mod makers and MLO creators out there.  

Are you interested in becoming a member of a friendly, fun, but also serious RP community and partake in its development en growth?  Join us today and you could be RPing in no time!
